segments.he: נִשְׁמָתְךָ וְשִׁמְךָ הֵם מֵהַשִּׁבְעָה דְּבָרִים שֶׁקָּדְמוּ לְהָעוֹלָם, עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתָּ שֶׁאַתָּה זוֹכֵר לָאו כְּלוּם שֶׁהוּא לְנֶפֶשׁ רוּחַ נְשָׁמָה????? קוֹדֵם.
וְאָמַרְתָּ שֶׁאַתָּה סָבָא דְּסָבִין וְזָקֵן שֶׁבַּזְּקֵנִים וַעֲדַיִן אַתָּה יַנִּיק לְגַמְרֵי וְלֹא הִתְחַלְתָּ לִחְיוֹת כְּלָל בָּעוֹלָם.
segments.en:
He told ancient stories of primordial times — to give life to fallen souls from seventy faces [of Torah],
    to return the king's daughter from her banishments — she who had fallen among the troops [=armies, the evil inclination] that are not good:
    — He is our Rabbainu.
    This refers to Rabbainu's holy Sipuray Ma'asiyos — the story-tales — which contain seventy dimensions of Torah meaning and have the power to raise souls that have fallen into the deepest impurity.

segments.he: וְעַל כֵּן אָמַרְתָּ שֶׁכָּל זְמַנֵּי הָעוֹלָם לְהֶרֶף עַיִן אֶצְלְךָ עוֹלִים, וְזָכִיתָ לְחַיִּים נִצְחִיִּים וְעָלֶיךָ נֶאֱמַר בְּנִי אַתָּה אֲנִי יְלִדְתִּיךָ הַיּוֹם.
segments.en:
The ten types of melody — recited together with the supplication [of the Tikkun HaKlali] —
    will accomplish the Tikkun HaKlali [general rectification] and raise up delights that have never before ascended:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: חִדּוּשׁ גָּדוֹל כְּנִשְׁמָתְךָ עֲדַיִן לֹא הָיָה מִשָּׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִים, נִשְׁמָתְךָ הִיא שׁוֹשַׁנָּה הַנְּתוּנָה בְּרֹאשׁ הַכִּסֵּא בַּמָּרוֹם.
segments.en:
These wonders are but the outermost edges of his ways — who can comprehend his greatness, who can grasp his worth?
    In every single moment that one reflects upon him — happy are we that we have merited this far:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: וּבַעֲווֹן הַדּוֹרוֹת וּמִפְּנֵי הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת מֻנַּחַת לְמַטָּה בְּהֶסְתֵּר וּבְהֶעְלֵם, עוֹד יָבֹא אֶחָד בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים.
אֲשֶׁר יַגְבִּיהֲךָ וְיַחְזִירְךָ לִמְקוֹמְךָ לְמַעְלָה בִּשְׁמֵי מָרוֹם, וְאָז תְּנַגֵּן הַנִּגּוּן הַנִּפְלָא בְּשִׁבְעִים וּשְׁנַיִם נִימִין.
segments.en:
His holiness — which he attained through his abundant separation from worldliness — through the greatness of his self-strengthening and the abundance of his prayer —
    there is no arriving at its depth of character, and silence is his praise:
    — He is our Rabbainu.
    "Silence is his praise" — the classic phrase (from Tehillim 65:2) indicating that which transcends all speech.

segments.he: אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא שֶׁל כָּל הַצַּדִּיקִים, עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתָּ שֶׁחִדּוּשׁ כְּמוֹתְךָ עֲדַיִן לֹא הָיָה בָּעוֹלָם.
segments.en:
At the head of every year — he commanded to gather at his holy grave faithfully,
    to pray with him together in joyful song, and to cry out with intention over the fall of the Kingdom [of Heaven]:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: מִגִּנְזֵי מְרוֹמִים נִמְשְׁכָה נִשְׁמָתְךָ וְיָרְדָה לַתַּחְתּוֹנִים, וְהוֹלִיכוּהָ בְּכָל הָעוֹלָמוֹת הָעֶלְיוֹנִים.
segments.en:
His disciples guard this — year after year to present themselves before him,
    breaking through for this purpose enormous obstacles — for this is their unique rectification before the Knower of Hidden Things:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: וְהִכְרִיזוּ לְפָנֶיהָ אִם יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁיֹּאמַר עָלֶיהָ חוֹבוֹת וַאֲשָׁמִים, וְלֹא נִמְצָא עָלֶיהָ שׁוּם חוֹב וְאָשָׁם.
segments.en:
The Torah of Hashem — which he attained through the abundance of his greatness, through the abundance of his humility and the greatness of his holiness —
    he made known to the heavenly dwellers: "Where is the place of His glory?" — and to the earthly dwellers: "The whole earth is full of His glory":
    — He is our Rabbainu.
    The two phrases are taken from the Kedushah prayer — the angels ask "where is the place of His glory?" while the earthly response proclaims "the whole earth is full of His glory." Rabbainu, standing between the heavenly and earthly worlds, conveyed the answer to both.

segments.he: וּבָא אֶחָד וְצָעַק רִבּוֹן הָעוֹלָמִים, עַל מָה שָׁוְא בְּרָאתַנִי לְהָסִית אֶת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם.
segments.en:
Our Rabbainu counseled us in all of this — to rejoice all our days,
    and in particular on our holy Shabbos — and to make dances in joy over our Yiddishkeit:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: אִם הַנְּשָׁמָה הַזֹּאת תֵּרֵד לַתַּחְתּוֹנִים אֵין לִי מַה לַּעֲשׂוֹת בָּעוֹלָם, וְהֵשִׁיבוּהוּ הַנְּשָׁמָה זֹאת לֵירֵד לְהָעוֹלָם.
segments.en:
To give tzedakah for the building of our faith — to make a restful and pure atmosphere in all our greatness,
    to speak words of faith with all who know us — and to believe in the individual Providence of our Creator:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: מֻכְרַחַת בִּשְׁבִיל תִּקּוּן הָעוֹלָם, וְאַתָּה תֵּן לְךָ עֵצוֹת וְתַחְבּוּלִים.
segments.en:
Renew our will at every time — without becoming confused by whatever passes over us,
    to hearken to the voice of Hashem today — and to do hisbodedus before Him day by day:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: נָתַן לְעַצְמוֹ אוֹתוֹ הָאֶחָד עֵצוֹת רָעִים, וְהֶעֱמִיד עָלֶיךָ אִישׁ אֶחָד מִן הַגְּדוֹלִים.
segments.en:
To draw down upon us the holiness of Eretz Yisroel — by guiding us upon our holy land,
    and through this we will merit length of patience — and to triumph in all our battles:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: אֲשֶׁר הוּא מִמַּכִּירָיו מִשָּׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִים, וְהִגְדִּיל שְׁמוֹ בָּעוֹלָם אִישׁ מְעַלֵּג שְׂפָתַיִם, אֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׁמַע אֶל קוֹל מְלַחֲשִׁים חֲכָמִים.
segments.en:
Be strong and let us strengthen ourselves through our good points — and judge ourselves and our fellows on the scale of merit,
    the wisdoms and tongues of the nations — let us distance from our mind — and let us live the life of eternity in the holiness of our Rabbainu.

segments.he: וְהִכְנִיס בְּלִבּוֹ עָלֶיךָ קִנְאָה וְשִׂנְאַת חִנָּם, וּבָדָה עָלֶיךָ דְּבָרִים שֶׁלֹּא הָיוּ מֵעוֹלָם, וְהִרְחִיק מִמְּךָ בְּנֵי הָעוֹלָם.
